description: UC Santa Barbara — strong CA in-state applicant, RD
rationale: UCSB anchor ~0.38 (post-2026-05-27 closure refresh; was 0.26 pre-refresh). UCSB's prod gpaDistribution is heavily top-loaded (96.5% of admits in 3.75-4.00), so a 3.85 / 1450 CA in-state applicant lands well above the 75th percentile and stacks gpaBand × testBand × geo (in-state) multipliers. Engine returns ~0.89 against fresh prod data. Upper bound widened to 0.95 to accommodate the post-closure-refresh reality; lower bound kept at 0.30 for safety against engine regressions. A Tier B follow-up tracks whether the cumulative-percentile gpaBand lift should be attenuated when the school's GPA distribution is itself top-heavy.
